blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods. All code and experiments can be found in our anonymized repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/XAI_SAE-0222 .
blocks.zh: 视觉Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)因其假定能够将模型所学到的复杂特征分解成单语义概念而成为机械解释学中流行的工具. 尽管它们越来越受欢迎,但评估它们的可解释性仍然是研究的一个积极议题。 推动采用SAEs的基石是线性表述假说(LRH),该假说声称,多语种特征可以投射到(接近)稀疏、人能理解的正统基础上。 然而,大多数现行框架都评价诸如SAE特征的伸缩性或所推断的词典的一致性等代词,暗含假定这些代词反映了与人类认知的一致性. 在本文中,我们提供了经验证据,证明衡量SAE概念的可解释性比这些代词所暗示的更困难. 为此,我们调整了 " 自动解释分数(AIS) " -- -- 以前在自然语言处理中显示与人类判断一致 -- -- ,使之适用于愿景任务,并在一项专门的用户研究中验证我们的方法。 我们既使用标准衡量标准,又使用我们经过调整的AIS评估SAE概念质量. 我们认为,SAE的既定可解释性衡量尺度彼此之间或与AIS之间都不相关,这表明,任何单一的无参考性衡量尺度,无论是否基于LRH,都不足以核实视觉SAE的可解释性。 我们认为,这些结论支持最近提出的对解释方法进行更可核查、更真实的设计和评估的呼吁。 所有代码和实验都见于我们的匿名寄存处:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/XAI_SAE-0222.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The field of Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) aims to reverse-engineer the computational sub-modules of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) into human-understandable algorithms ( Olah et al., 2020 ) . Central to this endeavor is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH) ( Park et al., 2024b ) , which posits that high-level, human-interpretable concepts are encoded as linear combinations of neurons within the model’s activation space. Under this hypothesis, disentangling these features becomes a primary objective for understanding model behavior ( Bereska and Gavves, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 机理解释(MI)领域旨在将深神经网络(DNNs)的计算子模块逆向化成人可理解的算法(Olah等人,2020年). 这一努力的核心是线性表达假说(LRH)(Park等人,2024年b),它假定高层次、人可解释的概念被编码为模型激活空间内神经元的线性组合。 在这个假设下,剥离这些特征成为理解模型行为的首要目标(Bereska and Gavves, 2024.).

blocks.en: However, a significant roadblock to this understanding is the phenomenon of polysemanticity , where individual neurons activate in multiple, semantically distinct contexts. Polysemanticity hinders the identification of concise, univocal explanations for network internals ( Huben et al., 2024 ) . Tightly related to this phenomenon is the superposition principle ( Elhage et al., 2022 ) , stating that DNNs represent more features than they have physical neurons by assigning them to an overcomplete set of non-orthogonal directions in the high-dimensional activation space. While efficient for compression, superposition renders the native basis of the network fundamentally uninterpretable.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种理解的一大障碍是多聚体抗体现象,即单个神经元在多种不同的情况下激活。 聚苯乙烯妨碍了对网络内部的简明、单一的解释的确定(Huben等人,2024年)。 与这一现象密切相关的是叠加原理(Elhage等人,2022年),称DNN通过在高维激活空间中将其分配到一组过度完整的非正统方向来代表比其物理神经元更多的特征. 虽然压缩效率高,但叠加使得网络的原生基础基本上无法解释.

blocks.en:
To resolve this, Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have recently emerged as a scalable unsupervised method to recover these "ghost" features ( Bricken et al., 2023 ) . An SAE comprises an encoder that projects dense model activations into a higher-dimensional, sparse latent space, and a decoder that reconstructs the original signal. By jointly minimizing reconstruction error and enforcing sparsity,
SAEs force the model to unpack superimposed features into distinct, monosemantic directions.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)最近作为一种可伸缩的无监督方法出现,以恢复这些"鬼神"特征(Bricken等人,2023年). 一个SAE包含一个编码器,将密集的模型激活投射到一个更高维度,稀有的潜伏空间,以及一个重建原始信号的解码器. 通过联合最小化重建错误 并强制实施垃圾,
SAEs迫使模型将叠加的特征拆解成不同的单语义方向.

blocks.en:
Results on how interpretable SAE features actually are remain, yet, inconclusive. While some studies ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Gujral et al., 2025 ; Paulo et al., 2025 ) present evidence that features learned by SAEs are more interpretable than native neurons, other authors ( Li et al., 2025 ; Korznikov et al., 2026 ; Hindupur et al., 2025 ; Paulo and Belrose, 2026 ; Chanin and Garriga-Alonso, 2026 ) highlight their instability and fragility.
Moreover, it is still debatable, what metrics and tools should be used to verify the interpretability of the SAE concepts and whether they genuinely align with human perception. In vision tasks, SAEs are very often evaluated only in terms of reconstruction error or the structure of the inferred dictionary, e.g. sparsity of the concept vector and orthogonality of the decoder matrix, omitting user studies to check whether the concepts are human-understandable. Some exceptions include e.g. Pach et al. (2026) , which validate their Monosemanticity Score (MS) in a human-in-the-loop (HIL) experiment. In Natural Language Processing (NLP), the community has devised the so-called Autointerpretability Score (AIS), which is meant to simulate the human explainer and was shown to correlate with human explanations ( Bills et al., 2023 ) . To the best of our knowledge, the literature on vision SAEs was lacking to this day such a measure of interpretability. Appendix A describes other established frameworks for automatically describing neurons in vision models, e.g. CLIP-Dissect ( Oikarinen and Weng, 2023 ) or MILAN ( Hernandez et al., 2022 ) . Yet, they either require a set of pre-annotated concepts or generate unlocalized broad explanations.
blocks.zh:
关于可解释的SAE特征的实际结果仍未确定。 虽然一些研究(Huben等人,2024年;Gujral等人,2025年;Paulo等人,2025年)提供了证据表明,SAE所学的特征比本地神经元更能解释,但其他作者(Li等人,2025年;Korznikov等人,2026年;Hindapur等人,2025年;Paulo和Belrose,2026年;Chanin和Garriga-Alonso,2026年)强调了它们的不稳定性和脆弱性。
此外,尚有待商榷的是,应使用何种衡量尺度和工具来核实SAE概念的可解释性,以及这些概念是否真正符合人类的认知。 在视觉任务中,SAE往往只从重建错误或推断的词典结构的角度来评价,例如,解码器矩阵的概念矢量和矫形的伸缩性,省略了用户研究,以检查这些概念是否人能理解. 有些例外包括例如: Pach等人(2026年),该实验验证了他们在人与人(HIL)实验中的单调分数(MS). 在自然语言处理(NLP)中,社区设计了所谓的自动解释分数(AIS),该分数旨在模拟人类解释器,并显示与人类解释相关(Bills等人,2023年)。 据我们所知,关于愿景的文献至今还缺乏这种可解释性。 附 录 A描述了在视觉模型中自动描述神经元的其他既定框架,例如. CLIP-Discept(Oikarien和Weng,2023年)或MILAN(Hernandez等人,2022年). 然而,它们要么需要一套预先说明的概念,要么产生非本地化的广义解释。

blocks.en: Our contributions in this work are as follows: 1) By leveraging recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose a recipe for adapting the AIS from NLP to vision SAEs and validate it in a dedicated user survey. 2) We show through extensive experiments that standard interpretability metrics for SAEs (whether derived from the LRH, describing the dictionary structure or specifically designed to measure concept disentanglement outside the dictionary structure) do not correlate. Thereby, we argue that concept alignment with human interpretation is a multi-faceted problem, which cannot be fully described by any single metric.
blocks.zh: 我们对这项工作的贡献如下: 1) 通过利用大语言模型(LLMs)最近的进展,我们提出了一个将AIS从NLP修改为视觉SAE的配方,并在专门的用户调查中予以验证. 2)我们通过广泛的实验表明,SAEs的标准可解释性衡量标准(无论是来自LRH,描述词典结构,还是专门用来测量词典结构之外的概念脱节)并不相关. 因此,我们主张,概念与人的解释相一致是一个多方面的问题,任何单一的衡量标准都无法充分描述。

blocks.en: By leveraging recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose a recipe for adapting the AIS from NLP to vision SAEs and validate it in a dedicated user survey.
blocks.zh: 通过利用近期在大语言模型(LLMs)方面的进步,我们提出了将AIS从NLP修改为视觉SAE的配方,并在专门的用户调查中予以验证.

blocks.en: We show through extensive experiments that standard interpretability metrics for SAEs (whether derived from the LRH, describing the dictionary structure or specifically designed to measure concept disentanglement outside the dictionary structure) do not correlate. Thereby, we argue that concept alignment with human interpretation is a multi-faceted problem, which cannot be fully described by any single metric.
blocks.zh: 我们通过广泛的实验表明,SAE的标准可解释性衡量标准(无论是来自LRH,描述词典结构,还是专门用来测量词典结构外的概念脱节)并不相关. 因此,我们主张,概念与人的解释相一致是一个多方面的问题,任何单一的衡量标准都无法充分描述。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
After wide adoption in NLP for explaining intermediate activations of LLMs, SAEs have gained increasing attention in Computer Vision (CV) as well.
While early approaches applied standard "Vanilla" ReLU-based L 1 L_{1} -constrained SAEs ( Bricken et al., 2023 ) to vision transformer embeddings ( Stevens et al., 2025 ; Olson et al., 2025 ) , recent work has explored more specialized architectures for enforcing sparsity and concept purity. Just to name a few examples: JumpReLU SAEs ( Rajamanoharan et al., 2025 ) , TopK SAEs ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Bussmann et al., 2024 ) , Matryoshka ( Bussmann et al., 2025 ) , Matching Pursuit (MP-SAE) ( Costa et al., 2025 ) , Archetypal (A-SAE) ( Fel et al., 2025 ) , Universal SAE ( Thasarathan et al., 2025 ) . In their original investigations, these SAE classes were trained to reconstruct "global" image features, e.g. the CLS token in standard transformer architectures such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) .
Other authors ( Lim et al., 2025 ; Stevens et al., 2025 ) target more localized concept learning and propose training SAEs on patch-level features, which any modern vision encoder extracts when tokenizing the image.
blocks.zh:
在NLP广泛采用解释LLMs中间激活后,SAE也在计算机视野(CV)中获得了越来越多的关注.
虽然早期的方法将基于“Vanilla”的基于L1 LQQ1}-约束的SAEs(Bricken等人,2023年)应用于视觉变压器嵌入(Stevens等人,2025年;Olson等人,2025年),但最近的工作探索了更专业的架构,以强制施压和概念纯度。 仅举几个例子: Jump ReLU SAES(Rajamanoharan等人,2025年),TopK SAEs(Gao等人,2025年;Bussmann等人,2024年),Matryoshka (Bussmann等人,2025年),《对等追逐》(MP-SAE)(Costa等人,2025年),Archetypal(A-SAE)(Fel等人,2025年),《通用SAE》(Tasarathan等人,2025年)。 在最初的调查中,这些SAE课程接受了重建"全球"图像特征的培训,例如CLIP(拉德福德等人,2021年)等标准变压器架构中的CLS符号.
其他作者(Lim等人,2025年;Stevens等人,2025年)针对更多本地化的概念学习,并提议对SAEs进行补丁级特征培训,任何现代视觉编码器在表示图像时都会提取.

blocks.en:
As far as SAE validation is concerned, verifying interpretability and identifying semantics within SAE neurons remains challenging.
Although meant as an MI tool, SAEs are oftentimes evaluated solely on indicators only indirectly related to interpretability, such as the reconstruction error, the sparsity of the concepts or the orthogonality of the inferred dictionary. While explanation simplicity is frequently cited as a desideratum ( Nauta and Seifert, 2023 ) , trading completeness for sparsity does not strike the right compromise and is known to erode users’ trust in the model’s prediction just as much as an overly complex explanation ( Afroogh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
就SAE验证而言,在SAE神经元内部验证可解释性和识别语义仍然具有挑战性.
虽然SAE作为一种管理工具的含义,但经常只根据与可解释性有关的间接指标来评价,例如重建错误、概念的伸缩性或推断词典的正统性。 虽然解释简便经常被引用为一种旁观(Nauta和Seifert, 2023年),但用Sparsity进行交易的完整性并不能得出正确的妥协,而且众所周知会削弱用户对该模型预测的信任,就像一种过于复杂的解释(Afroogh等人,2026年)一样。

blocks.en: Alternative proxies from the literature include: (i) approaches measuring the effect of SAEs on the downstream task performance ( Stevens et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Lim et al., 2025 ) or (ii) similarity-based approaches, e.g. in the explained input space, such as the Monosemanticity Score ( Pach et al., 2026 ) or w.r.t. to an external concept ontology such as WordNet ( Olson et al., 2025 ) . In ( Fel et al., 2025 ) , the authors look at various similarities in the dictionary learning process, e.g. the OOD score (similarity between the dictionary atoms and the image embeddings on which it was learned), Coherence (self-similarity of the dictionary itself) or Connectivity (self-similarity of the SAE features). We will return to some of these metrics later in section 5 .
blocks.zh: 文献中的其他代词包括:(一)衡量SAEs对下游任务性能的影响的方法(Stevens等人,2025年;Han等人,2025年;Lim等人,2025年)或(二)基于相似性的方法,例如在所解释的输入空间中,例如Monosemanticity Score(Pach等人,2026年)或w.r.t.到WordNet(Olson等人,2025年)等外部概念肿瘤学. 在(Fel et al.,2025)中,作者审视了词典学习过程中的各种相似之处,例如OD分数(词典原子和它所学习到的图像的相似性),一致性(词典本身的自我相似性)或连通性(SAE特征的自我相似性). 我们稍后将在第5节中回到其中一些标准。

blocks.en: Recently, more and more researchers in the XAI (Explainable AI) community are advocating for more formalization in the design of the explainers and supervision on ground truth explanations ( Haufe et al., 2026 ; Afroogh et al., 2026 ; Longo et al., 2024 ) . Fittingly, recent contributions in the SAE literature pick up this direction. For instance, Ding et al. (2025) utilize a pipeline with ground-truth Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and segmentation masks to evaluate how faithfully SAEs reconstruct specific visual concepts. Klotz et al. (2026) evaluate their interpretability against annotated concepts on CUB-200 ( Wah et al., 2011 ) and COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . Ding et al. (2025) propose Concept-SAE, which aligns the training process with user-defined concepts.
blocks.zh: 最近,XAI(解释性AI)社区越来越多的研究人员正在倡导在解释者的设计和监督实地真相解释方面更加正规化(Haufe等人,2026年;Afroogh等人,2026年;Longo等人,2024年)。 最近对SAE文献的贡献恰好证实了这个方向。 例如,丁 et等人. (2025) 利用带有地面真实视野-语言模型(VLM)和分区口罩的管道来评价SAE如何忠实地重建具体的视觉概念。 Klotz等人(2026年)对照CUB-200(Wah等人,2011年)和COCO(Lin等人,2014年)的附加说明的概念评价其可解释性。 Ding等人(2025年)提出概念-SAE,使培训过程与用户定义的概念保持一致.

blocks.en: The methodology of automated interpretability scoring was first introduced in the context of LLMs. ( Huben et al., 2024 ) established the baseline for this approach using the AIS, originally proposed by Bills et al. (2023) . By training SAEs on Pythia-70M ( Biderman et al., 2023 ) embeddings from OpenWebText ( Gokaslan et al., 2019 ) , they demonstrated that SAE features exhibit reduced polysemanticity compared to linear baselines like PCA and ICA (Independent Component Analysis), particularly in earlier model layers. Building on this, Paulo et al. (2025) scaled the analysis to millions of features across varied SAE architectures and activation functions trained on RedPajama-v2 ( Weber et al., 2024 ) . They also proposed more compute-efficient modifications to the AIS.
blocks.zh: 自动可解释性评分的方法最初是在有限责任公司的背景下提出的。 (Huben等人,2024年)使用最初由Bills等人(2023年)提议的AIS确定了这一方法的基准. 通过对Pythia-70M(Biderman等人,2023年)嵌入自OpenWebText(Gokaslan等人,2019年)的SAEs的培训,他们证明了SAE的特征显示与PCA和ICA(独立组件分析)等线性基线相比多聚性降低,特别是在早期的模型层. 在此基础上,Paulo等人(2025年)将分析范围扩大到各种SAE架构的数百万个特征,并针对RedPajama-v2进行了激活功能培训(Weber等人,2024年)。 他们还提议对人工智能系统进行更符合计算效率的修改。

blocks.en: The success of SAEs in NLP has extended to other sequence-based domains, such as Protein Language Models (PLMs). Gujral et al. (2025) applied TopK SAEs ( Gao et al., 2025 ) to the protein-level and amino-acid representations of an ESM2 model ( Lin et al., 2023 ) , treating protein sequences analogously to text. They validated the biological relevance of the resulting sparse features not only via AIS, but also through post-hoc Gene Ontology (GO) analysis, revealing strong associations between specific neurons and functional annotations in the UniProt database ( Consortium, 2020 ) .

blocks.zh: 3 用 SAE 进行词典学习

blocks.en: In this section we introduce the mathematical objects we will be working with throughout this paper and discuss the definition and assumptions of the LRH. In Appendix A we discuss more related work on the origins of sparse coding and dictionary learning.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍我们将在整个本文中与之合作的数学对象,并讨论LRH的定义和假设. 在附录A中,我们讨论了关于零星编码和字典学习起源的更多相关工作。

blocks.en: 3.2 Linear Representation Hypothesis
blocks.zh: 3.2 线性表述假设

blocks.en: SAEs have increasingly drawn attention in recent years, especially as MI has gained contour as a subfield within XAI. They promise to offer a straightforward post-hoc solution to the polysemanticity problem addressed in section 1 . The viability of SAEs as a solution to this problem is primarily motivated by the LRH, also known as the superposition hypothesis ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Elhage et al., 2022 ) . In this work, we will lean on the LRH formulation in ( Costa et al., 2025 ) : "[…] high-dimensional neural representations can be decomposed as superpositions over a large set of approximately orthogonal directions, each aligned with human-interpretable concepts."

blocks.en: Figure 1: AIS Pipeline: (1) Train SAE on patch embeddings. (2) Split images into a grid and caption every grid patch. (3) For a given neuron k ∗ k^{*} , feed pairs of patch captions and activations from 5 high activating images into the LLM-explainer and prompt it to infer the common concept. (4) In reverse, show the LLM-simulator pairs of patch captions along with the previously inferred explanation (5 from high-activating images, 5 from random images) and prompt it to predict the neuron activations per patch. (5) Compute the AIS of the neuron k ∗ k^{*} as the Pearson correlation between predicted and true patch activations.
blocks.zh: 图1:AIS管道: (1) 补丁嵌入式SAE列车。 (2)将图像分割成网格,并对每个网格补丁进行字幕. (3)对于给定的神经元k * kQQ,从5个高激活图像中输入补丁标题的对子和激活到LLM-解释器中,并促使它推断共同的概念. (4)反之,显示LLM-模拟器的对补丁标题以及之前推断的解释(5个来自高激活图像,5个来自随机图像),并促使它预测每个补丁的神经元激活. (5)将神经元k * k^{*}的AIS计算为预测的和真实的补丁激活之间的皮尔逊关联.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 outlines our proposed adaptation scheme of AIS for Vision SAEs.
The first step consists of training an SAE to reconstruct the embeddings e ≈ e ^ e\approx\hat{e} . Once fully trained, only the encoder module will be used further to generate the sparse codes z z .
blocks.zh:
图1概述了我们拟议的 " 面向 " SAE的AIS " 适应计划。
第一步包括培训一个SAE来重建嵌入式 e ^ e\\\\ hat{e} 。 完全训练后,只有编码器模块会被进一步用于生成稀疏的代码z z.

blocks.en:
In a parallel second step , the images are split into
patches and each grid patch is annotated by a captioning model. This is where the novelty arises when transferring the AIS method from language to vision. When it comes to text, AIS localizes SAE-learned concepts on the token level, depending on which tokens in a body of text activate a specific neuron in the SAE. For images, this operation is not as straightforward. While modern embedders do split up images into "tokens" (patches), most vision SAEs are trained on full image embeddings, which does not match conceptually with the idea of AIS. Hence, we propose working with patch-level embeddings and SAE activations here, to allow similar iterations for the AIS as in the textual scenario. The captions are, therefore, meant to translate the image patches into sentences.
Note that the captioning grid resolution is a hyperparameter and will highly influence the quality of the downstream explanations.
blocks.zh:
在平行的第二步中,图像被分割成
补丁和每个网格补丁都用标题模型附加说明. 这就是在将AIS方法从语言转移到视觉时产生新奇之处. 在文本方面,AIS将SAE-在符位上学习的概念本地化,这取决于文本正文中哪些符位激活了SAE中的特定神经元. 对于图像来说,这个操作并不那么直截了当. 虽然现代嵌入器确实将图像分解为"tokens"(patches),但大多数视觉SAE都是在完整图像嵌入上进行训练,这在概念上与AIS的想法并不吻合. 因此,我们建议在此使用补丁级嵌入和SAE激活,以便允许AIS的类似迭代,如文字方案。 因此,标题意在将图像补丁翻译为句子。
请注意,标题网格分辨率是一个超参数,将高度影响下游解释的质量.

blocks.en: The third step is the explanation generation. For a subset K ∗ K^{*} of relevant SAE neurons (see Appendix D ), we select the top 10 images that maximize (by average of patches) each neuron’s activation. Then, an explainer (in form of an LLM) is shown the pairs of captions and normalized 2 2 2 Following Bills et al. (2023) , we normalize activations onto a discrete 0-10 integer interval. Negative values are mapped to 0, the maximum value in that neuron is mapped to 10. patch activation scores for 5 of those images. The explainer is prompted to infer the common explanation/concept for which that particular neuron fires. An example of an explained neuron can be seen in Figure 5 in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 第三步是解释生成. 对于相关SAE神经元的子集 K ∗ K ^{*}(见附录D),我们选择了最大(以补丁平均值)每个神经元激活的十大图像. 然后,一个解释器(以 LLM 形式) 被显示为标题的对, 并正常化 2 2 之后的 Bills et al. (2023), 我们正常的激活到一个离散的 0-10 整数间隔 。 负值被映射到0,神经元中的最大值被映射到10. 其中5个图像的补丁激活分数 促使解释者推断出该特定神经元火灾的共同解释/概念。 解释神经元的一个例子可见于附录中的图5.

blocks.en: In the fourth step , another or the same LLM acts as a simulator. Based on the previously inferred explanation, the other top 5 activating images (namely, their patch captions) and 5 other random images (known as the "top-random" approach ( Huben et al., 2024 ) ), the LLM is prompted to predict the SAE activation score for every patch (see an example in Figure 6 in the Appendix).
blocks.zh: 第四步中,另一个或同一个LLM充当模拟器. 根据之前推断的解释,其他前5位激活图像(即他们的补丁标题)和另外5位随机图像(称为"顶随机"方法(Huben等人,2024年)),LLM被激励来预测每个补丁的SAE激活分数(参见附录图6中的一个例子).

blocks.en: In the final fifth step , we compute the AIS per explained neuron as the Pearson correlation between the ground truth patch activation scores A truth A_{\text{truth}} and the simulated ones A ^ pred \hat{A}_{\text{pred}} . The average of all the neuron-wise AIS values gives the Mean AIS as a global measure of interpretability for the SAE.
blocks.zh: 在最后的第五步,我们计算每个被解释的神经元的AIS,作为Pearson在地面真理补丁激活得分AQQText{ truth}}与模拟的A^ pred\hat{A}_{\Text{pred}}}之间的关联. 所有神经元AIS值的平均值使平均AIS成为衡量SAE可解释性的全球尺度.

blocks.en:
The pseudocode in algorithm 1 gives an overview of our AIS experiments.
We run the experiments described in this paper on the following datasets: CUB-200-2011 ( Wah et al., 2011 ) , 5794 samples; a subset of ImageNet ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) with 100 classes containing around 200 samples each - we denote it here as ImageNet100
; and Caltech 101 ( Li et al., 2022a ) , 4572 samples. For CUB, we applied the standard split that comes with downloading the dataset. As for the other two, we applied a fixed-seed stratified split of 0.5-0.5 into training and validation sets. We extract embeddings from the images in these datasets with various embedders ε \varepsilon , namely: DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , ViT ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) and SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) . While we conduct experiments on single-object, object-centric datasets, our approach can readily be applied on other vision benchmarks as well.
blocks.zh:
算法1中的伪码概括了我们的AIS实验.
我们运行了本文中描述的关于下列数据集的实验:CUB-200-2011(Wah等人,2011年),5794个样本;ImageNet的一个子集(Russakovsky等人,2015年),100个类别,每个类别包含约200个样本——我们在此表示ImageNet100.
;和Caltech 101(Li等人,2022a),4572个样本. 对于CUB,我们应用了随着下载数据集而来的标准拆分. 至于另外两个,我们把0.5-0.5的固定种子分级法用于培训和鉴定。 我们从这些数据集的图像中提取嵌入器 \\\ varepsilon,即: DINOv2(Oquab等人, 2024年), ViT (Dosovitskiy等人,2021年)和SigLIP(Zhai等人,2023年). 当我们对单一物体、以物体为中心的数据集进行实验时,我们的方法也很容易地适用于其他的远景基准。

blocks.en: As noted above, the captioning grid size is a hyperparameter that influences the quality of the explanations. After several iterations, we settled for a grid size of 4 as a middle ground. Hence, we split each image into a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid and caption each patch using LLaVa 1.5 ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . Example captions can be found in the Appendix. We limit the maximum number of generated caption tokens to 100 and prompt the model as follows: Directly describe the texture, shapes, and colors visible in this close-up image. Be concise and focus only on visual details.
blocks.zh: 如上所述,标题网格大小是影响解释质量的超参数。 经过几次迭代后,我们定居的网格大小为4作为中间点. 因此,我们利用LLaVa 1.5(Liu等人,2023年)将每个图像分成4×4 4\times 4网格和标题。 示例说明见附录。 我们把生成的标题符号的最大数量限制在100个,并提示模型如下: 直接描述这个特写图像中可见的纹理,形状,颜色. 简明扼要,只注重视觉细节.

blocks.en: As explainer and simulator we tested various modern open-weight LLMs that can be run on-premise, namely from the Gemma 3 ( Gemma-Team, 2025 ) and Gemma 4 ( Gemma-Team, 2026 ) families. We decided to use the same model as both explainer and simulator, but note that one can delegate two different models for the two tasks (see e.g. Huben et al. (2024) ).
blocks.zh: 作为解释者和模拟者,我们测试了各种现代开放量级的LLMs,这些LMs可以在前提上运行,分别来自Gemma 3(Gemma-Team,2025年)和Gemma 4(Gemma-Team,2026年)家庭. 我们决定使用与解释器和模拟器相同的模型,但注意到一个人可以委托两个不同的模型来完成这两个任务(例如参见. Huben等人(2024年)).

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: In this section, we present our findings and discuss their possible interpretations and implications.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍我们的结论,并讨论其可能的解释和影响。

blocks.en: Previous research in NLP has shown through HIL experiments that LLM explanations align well with human judgments ( Bills et al., 2023 ) . To the best of our knowledge, a similar investigation was missing for vision tasks. To this end, we designed a user survey, in order to verify the soundness of our vision AIS procedure. The design of the experiment is described in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 以往在NLP的研究通过HIL实验表明,LLM解释与人类判决一致(Bills等人,2023年)。 据我们所知,对愿景任务缺乏类似的调查。 为此,我们设计了用户调查,以核实我们愿景AIS程序是否合理。 试验的设计在附录G中描述.

blocks.en: Plot (a) in Figure 3 shows a positive correlation - yet rather imprecisely estimated given the small sample size - between the image-level AIS values achieved by Gemma and survey participants: coefficient r = 0.6202 , at a p-value of 0.0237 and a 95% confidence interval [0.133, 0.866] (via Fisher’s z-transformation). This suggests that the caption-based adaption of AIS is able to describe SAE concept quality similar to how human explainers perceive it. Out of the 20 simulation images used in the survey we excluded 6 degenerate cases (all-zero ground-truth SAE scores) from plot (a) and analyzed them separately in plot (b). The LLM correctly identified 4 of these cases, while 7 out of 16 users also managed to identify all or almost all of them. Upon manual inspection, we confirmed that these users formulated more detailed descriptions of the concepts in the first task than the rest - Figure 9 . Qualitatively, this gives reassurance that i) the LLM simulator does not tend to hallucinate activation scores where the concept is absent and ii) users are also able to correctly annotate trivial cases, provided they find a concept specific enough in the explanation task. For a second part of the discussion regarding degenerate cases, see our ablation study in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 图3中的图(a)显示Gemma和调查参与者在图像级AIS值之间正相关,但考虑到样本规模较小,估计不准确:系数r=0.6202,p值为0.0237,置信间隔为95%[0.133,0.866](通过Fisher的z转换)。 这表明AIS基于标题的适应性能够描述SAE概念质量,类似于人类解释者如何看待它. 在调查中使用的20个模拟图像中,我们从图(a)中排除了6个退化病例(全部为零地面真实的SAE分数),并在图(b)中分别分析。 LLM正确确定了其中的4个病例,而16个用户中有7个也设法确定了其中的全部或部分。 经过人工检查,我们确认这些用户对第一项任务中的概念的描述比其他任务更为详细----图9。 在定性上,这可以保证,一)LLM模拟器在概念缺失时不会倾向于幻觉激活分数,二)用户也可以正确注释小案件,前提是他们在解释任务中发现一个足够具体的概念. 关于堕落案例的讨论第二部分,见附录H。

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) LLM-AIS correlates with Human-AIS. Each point represents a non-degenerate survey image (14 in total). All AIS values are computed on the [ 0 , 2 ] [0,2] score range. (b) 7/16 users outperform the LLM in recognizing trivial all-zero cases.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) LLM-AIS与Human-AIS相关。 每个点代表一个非退化的勘测图像(共14个). 所有AIS值均在[0,2][0,2]分数范围内计算. (b) 7/16个用户在识别无足轻重的全零病例方面比LLM做得更好。

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares the individual AIS on the two neurons for the Gemma Explainer/Simulator against the users. The results indicate that our automated LLM pipeline outperforms human users in extracting explanations and simulating activations, even when the image material is translated into captions and the activation range is more fine-grained. This, along with the random shuffling test in Table 2 , is another proof of concept in favor of the caption-based adaptation of the AIS procedure.
blocks.zh: 图3将Gemma解释器/模拟器的两个神经元上的单个AIS与用户进行比较. 结果显示,我们的自动LLM管道在提取解释和模拟激活方面优于人类用户,即使图像材料被转换成标题,激活范围更加精细. 这与表2中的随机乱排测试一起,是支持基于标题的AIS程序修改概念的又一证明.

blocks.en: After inspecting the users’ explanations for both neurons ( Figure 9 ), we learned that the simulation task was notably more challenging, even though most users successfully identified "branches" and "water" as concepts, similar to Gemma’s explanations. This is also indicated by the fairly high disagreement rate between users (in form of the standard deviations in Figure 3 ). This insight can be used to further optimize the efficiency of the AIS pipeline, e.g. by using a lower-scale LLM for explanation than for simulation (see Huben et al. (2024) ).
blocks.zh: 在检查了用户对两个神经元的解释(图9)后,我们得知模拟任务明显更具挑战性,尽管大多数用户成功地将"branches"和"water"确定为概念,类似于Gemma的解释. 这一点也表现在用户之间相当高的分歧率(以图3中的标准偏差的形式)。 这种洞察力可以用来进一步优化AIS管道的效率,例如通过使用比模拟低尺度的LLM来解释(见Huben等人(2024).

blocks.en: Table 1: High reconstruction - low interpretability. Best results are marked in green , worst results in red . More statistics accompanying the AIS values are collected in Table 3 from the Appendix. In particular, note that Sparsity, as defined in Equation 4 and in the overcomplete library ( Fel, 2024 ) , actually measures density (meaning a higher value is denser).
blocks.zh: 表1:高重建----低可解释性。 最佳成绩为绿色,最糟糕的结果为红色。 附录中的表3收集了更多与人工智能指数值相关的统计数据。 尤其要注意的是,在方程式4和过度完整的库(Fel, 2024)中定义的Sparsity实际上测量密度(表示更高的值是密度).

blocks.en:
Table 1 confirms a trade-off well documented in the SAE and XAI literature ( Herm et al., 2023 ; Crook et al., 2023 ) : A high reconstruction potential does not guarantee the SAE is also interpretable. While all SAE configurations reach a high R 2 R^{2} score on reconstructing the embeddings, all other interpretability metrics indicate that the SAE features are still rather opaque. In particular, all configurations achieve very high OOD, Coherence and Connectivity scores; the only exception here is the Coherence below 0.5 for the Vanilla SAEs. Also immediately visible is the maximum Connectivity for almost all the configurations, giving a first piece of evidence that the SAE concepts remain polysemantic.
On the opposite side, AIS and MS are both low and extremely low, respectively, none of them surpassing 0.5. When compared against baselines from the literature: Our vision SAEs trained here on patch-level embeddings achieve a much lower MS range - [ 4 × 10 − 4 , 1.06 × 10 − 1 ] [4\times 10^{-4},1.06\times 10^{-1}] - than their counterparts trained on image-level embeddings from the original paper introducing the MS score ( Pach et al., 2026 ) - roughly [ 0.1 , 0.6 ] [0.1,0.6] for a similar SAE expansion factor as ours on the final embeddings. As for the AIS: Our vision SAEs compare favorably against SAEs explaining LLMs ( Huben et al., 2024 ) and are surpassed by SAEs explaining PLMs ( Gujral et al., 2025 ) (also refer to Table 2 ). In terms of sparsity-interpretability trade-off: MP-SAEs fall out as achieving comparable results as the other SAEs, while trained on a much lower sparsity regime.
This highlights again the argument introduced in section 2 : The balance between explanation simplicity (approximated here in the form of sparsity of SAE features) and completeness is difficult to find and describe accurately.
blocks.zh:
表1证实了SAE和XAI文献中记载的权衡结果(Herm等人,2023年;Crook等人,2023年): 高的重建潜力不能保证SAE也可以解释. 虽然所有SAE配置在重建嵌入物时都达到一个高R 2 R^{2}的得分,但所有其他可解释性衡量标准都表明SAE特征仍然相当不透明. 特别是,所有配置都取得了极高的OOD,一致性和连通性分数;这里唯一的例外是Vanilla SAEs低于0.5. 同样立即可见的还有几乎所有配置的最大连通性,给出了第一个证据,即SAE概念仍然是多语种的.
反之,AIS和MS分别为低和极低,无一超过0.5. 对照文献的基线: 我们在此接受补丁级嵌入培训的SAE实现的MS范围要低得多——[4×10−4,1.06×10−1][4\时为10×4},1.06\时为10×1]——比在介绍MS分数(Pach等人,2026年)的原始文件中接受过图像级嵌入培训的对应方达到大约[0.1,0.6] [0.1,0.6] [0.6],用于一个类似于我们最终嵌入的SAE扩展系数。 至于AIS:我们的愿景SAEs与解释LLMs的SAEs(Huben等人,2024年)相比优异,被解释PLMs的SAEs超越(Gujral等人,2025年)(另见表2)。 在sparsity-解释性权衡方面:MP-SAEs脱颖而出,以取得与其他SAE相似的结果,同时接受关于一个低得多的sparsity制度的培训.
这再次凸显了一节中提出的论点。 2个: 解释简单(此处以SAE特征的Sparsity形式近似)与完整性之间的平衡很难找到和准确描述.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Correlation matrix on the SAE metrics. Except (Sparsity - OOD Score), none of the other pairs correlate as expected.
blocks.zh: 图4:关于SAE指标的关联矩阵。 除(比例-OOD分数)外,其他对子均无预期关联。

blocks.en: Figure 4 depicts the correlation matrix between the metrics in Table 1 . What we learn from it is that standard SAE evaluation metrics (for reconstruction and interpretability) do not correlate more than moderately, except for three cases: (Sparsity - OOD Score), (Sparsity - Coherence) and (OOD Score - Coherence). While the threshold for a "high correlation" is subjective and task-dependent, we consider here ± 0.6 \pm 0.6 to be suitable ( Akoglu, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 图4显示了表1中衡量尺度之间的相互关系矩阵。 我们从中吸取的教训是,标准SAE评价指标(用于重建和可解释性)的关联性不超过中度,只有三种情况除外:(比例-OD分数)、(比例-一致性)和(指数-一致性)。 虽然"高度关联"的门槛是主观的和任务依赖的,但我们在此认为±0.6\pm 0.6是合适的(Akoglu,2018).

blocks.en:
Note that while Sparsity and Coherence, which are central pieces of the LRH ( subsection 3.2 ), do correlate strongly, the negative relationship of this correlation contradicts the requirements of the LRH, namely sparse near-orthogonal dictionaries. According to these assumptions, one would expect to observe sparse features and low-coherence dictionaries together. Similarly for OOD Score vs Coherence, where a positive correlation was to be expected. Only Sparsity and OOD Score exhibit an expected high positive correlation.
Of particular interest are MS and AIS, which were designed to measure interpretability from outside the dictionary structure. MS and AIS do not appear to correlate w.r.t. each other; w.r.t. the other metrics, none of them are highly correlated.
blocks.zh:
请注意,虽然作为LRH(第3.2分节)核心部分的Sparsity and Concession确实密切相关,但这种关联的负面关系与LRH的要求相矛盾,即稀疏的近正统字典. 根据这些假设,人们预期会看到稀少的特征和低一致性的词典。 同样,OO 分数与一致性也存在相似之处,在一致性方面预期会出现正相关关系。 只有Sparsity和OO得分显示预期的高正比关系。
特别令人感兴趣的是MS和AIS,它们旨在从词典结构之外衡量可解释性。 MS和AIS似乎并不互相关联;W.r.t.其他的衡量标准,没有一个高度关联。

blocks.en:
We experimented with various Gemma models as explainers and simulators, on a fixed configuration Vanilla SAE + DINO + CUB ( Table 2 ). While some lower scale Gemma versions struggled as explainers and simulators, some versions of as few as 4B parameters achieved similar AIS values as models of three or six times their size.
We run Gemma inference on-premise to generate the explanations and simulate the activations for all versions up to 12B parameters. Gemma4-26b is called in the cloud via Google’s API in the Google AI Studio.
Note that our AIS results with much smaller LLM explainers/simulators are comparable to similar AIS experiments from the NLP and PLM literature ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Gujral et al., 2025 ) . For reference: GPT 4 ( OpenAI, 2024 ) is estimated to have 1.8 trillion and Claude 3.5 Sonnet ( Anthropic, 2024 ) 175B parameters.
For the investigations here, we computed the AIS on the top 100 SAE features (not 200 as in the other experiments). The baseline results from Gujral et al. (2025) take 200 features into consideration, those from Huben et al. (2024) look at 150, both w.r.t. the final layer embeddings.
To check the validity of the LLaVa captions, we run a randomized test on Gemma4-12b. By randomly shuffling the patch captions for every explained neuron, we arrive at a much lower (even negative) AIS.

blocks.en:
One of the contributions of this paper is the adaptation of the AIS routine from sequence-to-sequence modeling to vision. The central piece of transition is given by the captioning step ( algorithm 1 , Figure 1 ). While our experiments indicate that translating patch-level embeddings into text and delegating a lower-scale LLM to simulate a human explainer is a reasonable choice, achieves comparable results to baselines from the SAE literature and aligns with human explanations,
several limitations are evident.
blocks.zh:
本文的贡献之一是将AIS常规从序列模型化到序列模型化到视觉. 中心过渡段由标题步骤(算法1,图1)给出. 虽然我们的实验表明,将补丁级嵌入到文字中并授权一个低级的LLM来模拟人类解释器是一个合理的选择,实现与SAE文献的基线的可比结果,并与人类解释保持一致,
有几个限制是显而易见的。

blocks.en: The cross-modality introduced into the AIS pipeline (vision embeddings → \rightarrow text captions) may be a form of lossy compression, as it is discarding visual information when captioning the patches. Figure 7 in the Appendix gives an overview of the frequency of the top 20 words/concepts found in the Gemma-generated explanations for all configurations listed in Table 1 . Notice that most terms are rather generic, which, in turn, will impact the quality of the simulated activation scores. As mentioned above, the captioner’s performance is highly relevant for the quality of the explanations. Likewise, the performance of the LLM Explainer and Simulator impacts the AIS. Given this chain of error propagation, it is, hence, not entirely clear to what extent a low AIS can be solely attributed to poor interpretability of SAE concepts.
blocks.zh: 引入AIS管道的交叉模式(视觉嵌入 →\ 右旋文本标题)可能是一种失落的压缩形式,因为它在给补丁字幕时会丢弃视觉信息. 附录中的图7概述了Gemma生成的关于表1所列所有配置的解释中发现的前20个字/概念的频率。 注意大多数术语相当通用,这反过来会影响模拟激活分数的质量. 如上文所述,字幕员的表现与解释的质量密切相关。 同样,LLM解释器和模拟器的性能也影响了AIS. 鉴于错误传播的这一链条,因此,不清楚在多大程度上低人工智能可完全归因于SAE概念的解释性差。

blocks.en:
The grid resolution on which the captioner is applied naturally impacts the level of detail from which the LLM explainer infers the explanation. While meant to equate the tokenization step in the AIS for sequence modeling, a static grid does not include any scene understanding whatsoever. As an alternative, other modern patching and captioning methods may be applied, that combine both steps into one and segment the image into irregular dynamic regions
- see Appendix A . Furthermore, latest VLMs
would be able to solve the explanation and simulation tasks by directly analyzing the images, without needing captions at all.
blocks.zh:
使用标题的网格分辨率自然影响到LLM解释者推断解释的详细程度. 静态网格虽然意在将AIS中的标志化步骤等同于序列建模,但并不包括任何场景理解. 作为一种替代办法,可采用其他现代补丁和字幕方法,将两个步骤合并为一个步骤,并将图像分割成不规则动态区域
- 见附录A。 此外,最新的自愿多数
可以通过直接分析图像来解决解释和模拟任务,而不需要标题。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we challenged the LRH on the basis of which SAEs are built. We have shown empirically that standard metrics designed to evaluate the interpretability of SAEs - whether from within or outside the concept dictionary - do not correlate with one another or with the AIS. We proposed an adaption of the AIS for vision models, previously shown in NLP to align with human explanations, and confirmed via a dedicated user study that our caption-based AIS procedure captures explanation quality as perceived by humans.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们挑战了作为SAE基础的LRH. 我们从经验上表明,旨在评估SAE的可解释性的标准衡量标准,无论是从概念词典内部还是外部,都不相互相关,也不与AIS相关。 我们提议对AIS进行视觉模型的改造,先前在NLP中显示,以便与人类的解释保持一致,并通过专门的用户研究确认,我们基于字幕的AIS程序能够捕捉人类所认为的解释质量。

blocks.en: Our results support a growing line of work in explainability calling for more formalism in explanation methods ( Haufe et al., 2026 ; Afroogh et al., 2026 ) , deeper understanding of XAI metrics ( Biessmann and Refiano, 2021 ) , noise and uncertainty in explanations, supervision and ground-truth data for explainers and greater customization to task and audience ( Longo et al., 2024 ; Chiaburu, 2026 ) . For vision SAEs, new results show the benefits of steering the interpretability of SAE features via human-annotated concepts ( Klotz et al., 2026 ) or describing concepts beyond LRH-assumed linear separability ( Hindupur et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的结果支持在可解释性方面日益增加的工作,要求在解释方法上采取更正式的做法(Haufe等人,2026年;Afroogh等人,2026年),加深对XAI指标的理解(Biessmann和Refiano,2021年),解释者在解释、监督和地面真相数据方面的噪音和不确定性,以及对任务和受众的更定制(Longo等人,2024年;Chiaburu,2026年)。 就愿景SAE而言,新的结果表明,通过人为附加概念(Klotz等人,2026年)或描述超出LRH假设线性分离的概念(Hindapur等人,2025年)来引导SAE特征的可解释性是有益的。

blocks.en: To conclude, more in-depth studies are needed on the efficiency and interpretability of SAEs, beyond standard LRH assumptions. We believe that, just like with any explanation method, there is no all-purpose SAE design guaranteed to deliver useful explanations across data and models. Task domain knowledge and reality-grounded metrics need to be interwoven into SAE training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 最后,除了标准的LRH假设之外,还需要对SAE的效率和可解释性进行更深入的研究. 我们认为,与任何解释方法一样,没有保证提供各种数据和模型的有用解释的通用SAE设计。 需要将任务领域知识和基于现实的衡量标准与SAE培训和评价结合起来。

blocks.en: The debate between sparse and distributed coding mechanisms has its roots in neuroscience research. On the one hand, the sparse coding hypothesis, often colloquially termed as the "Grandmother Cell" theory, posits that specific neurons exhibit extreme selectivity, firing exclusively in response to high-level, complex stimuli regardless of visual presentation or context. Empirical support for this localized representation stems from single-unit recordings in the human medial temporal lobe (MTL) ( Quian Quiroga et al., 2005 ; Kreiman et al., 2000 ) , which identified concept-specific neurons that fired selectively for specific individuals (such as Jennifer Aniston), places or objects. On the other hand, the distributed coding theory asserts that information is encoded across a population of neurons, not by individual cells. This framework accounts for the brain’s capacity to represent a virtually unlimited array of stimuli using a limited number of neurons. This population-based view is widely supported across sensory and cognitive domains, as demonstrated by functional neuroimaging and electrophysiological studies ( Haxby et al., 2001 ; Norman et al., 2006 ) .
blocks.zh: 稀疏和分布式编码机制之间的争论的根源在于神经科学研究. 一方面,稀疏的编码假说,常被合称为"祖母细胞"理论,认为特定的神经元表现出极端的选择性,完全针对高水平,复杂的刺激发射,无论视觉表现或上下文如何. 对这种本地化代表的实证支持源于人类介质时叶(MTL)(Quian Quiroga等人,2005年;Kreiman等人,2000年)的单单元录制,该录制确定了针对特定个体(如Jennifer Aniston),地点或物体有选择地发射的特定概念神经元. 另一方面,分布式编码理论则断言,信息是在整个神经元群中编码的,而不是由单个细胞编码的. 这个框架说明大脑有能力使用有限的神经元代表几乎无限的刺激。 这种基于人群的观点在感官和认知领域得到了广泛支持,功能神经成像和电生理学研究就证明了这一点(Haxby等人,2001年;Norman等人,2006年)。

blocks.en: The modern use of SAEs for MI in neural networks is rooted in foundational principles of overcomplete basis functions, sparse coding and Independent Component Analysis (ICA). The core premise that natural signals can be efficiently represented as sparse linear combinations of an overcomplete set of basis vectors was first established in the late 90’s ( Olshausen and Field, 1996 ; Olshausen and Field, 1997 ) . Experiments showed that imposing a sparsity constraint on overcomplete representations yields localized, Gabor-like visual filters analogous to simple cells in the primary visual cortex. This computational paradigm shares strong theoretical links with ICA, as both seek to untangle complex distributions into independent, interpretable components. While ICA explicitly enforces statistical independence among the source components, sparse coding optimizes for structural sparsity where only a small subset of basis elements is active simultaneously. Later formalized into sparse dictionary learning frameworks using optimization algorithms like LASSO and iterative thresholding ( Jenatton et al., 2010 ) , these techniques provided a principled approach to learning dictionary matrices and sparse coefficients end-to-end. SAEs directly adapt this dictionary learning paradigm to modern Deep Learning architectures. By introducing an explicit sparsity penalty to the latent bottleneck, e.g. through L 1 L_{1} regularization, SAEs force the network to reconstruct dense internal activations through a small combination of monosemantic latent directions.
blocks.zh: 现代在神经网络中将SAEs用于MI,植根于基础功能过度完备,编码不足和独立组件分析(ICA)等基本原则. 自然信号可以被有效表示为一组过于完整的基向量的稀疏线性组合的核心前提最早建立于90年代末(Olshausen and Field,1996年;Olshausen and Field,1997年)。 实验表明,对过度完整的表达施加痉挛限制会产生局部的类似Gabor的视觉滤波器,类似于初级视觉皮层中的简单细胞。 这种计算范式与ICA有着很强的理论联系,因为两者都寻求将复杂的分布解析为独立的,可解释的组件. 虽然ICA在源元件中明确执行统计独立性,但是在只有一小部分基础元件同时活跃的情况下,稀疏的编码优化了结构伸缩性. 后来通过LASSO和迭代阈值(Jenatton等人,2010年)等优化算法,正式形成稀疏的词典学习框架,这些技术为学习词典矩阵和稀疏的末端系数提供了原则性方法. SAEs直接将本词典学习范式适应现代深层学习架构. 通过对潜在的瓶颈实行明显的痉挛惩罚,例如通过L 1 L_{1}正规化,SAEs迫使网络通过单一语义的潜在方向小组合重建密集的内部激活。

blocks.en: In order to strike a bridge between sequence modeling and vision w.r.t. automatic interpretability evaluation, our work introduces a captioning step. Conventional VLMs, such as BLIP ( Li et al., 2022b ) and ViT-GPT2 ( Mishra et al., 2024 ) , are predominantly trained on image-level descriptions such as COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , resulting in a significant object-centric inductive bias that favors holistic descriptions over fine-grained visual textures. While CLIP-based methods ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jin, 2023 ) attempt to align visual and textual embeddings, they typically operate at a global scale. Recent instruction-tuned VLMs like InstructBLIP ( Dai et al., 2023 ) and LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ) introduce spatial/context awareness via prompting.
blocks.zh: 为了在测序模型和视觉W.r.t.自动解释性评价之间搭建桥梁,我们的工作引入了一个标题步骤。 常规VLM,如BLIP(Li等人,2022b)和VIT-GPT2(Mishra等人,2024年)主要接受图像级描述的培训,如COCO(Lin等人,2014年),导致一个以物体为中心的诱导偏差,倾向于整体描述而不是精细的视觉纹理. 虽然基于CLIP的方法(Radford等人,2021年;Jin,2023年)试图将视觉和文字嵌入对齐,但它们通常在全球范围内运作. 近期的指令调整VLM,如InstructBLIP(Dai等人,2023年)和LLaVA(Liu等人,2023年)通过提示引入了空间/背景意识.

blocks.en: Other recent work has shifted towards detailed localized captioning (DLC) and dense captioning. Frameworks such as Segment and Caption Anything (SCA) ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and the Describe Anything Model (DAM) ( Lian et al., 2025 ) leverage the Segment Anything Model (SAM) ( Ravi et al., 2025 ; Carion et al., 2026 ) to generate context-aware descriptions for arbitrary regions and masks. Bianchi et al. (2026) propose the Patch-ioner framework, which adopts a patch-centric paradigm to aggregate patch representations into coherent descriptions of non-contiguous areas.
blocks.zh: 最近的其他工作已转向详细的本地化标题和密集标题。 诸如Seption和Caption Anything(SCA)(黄.等人,2024年)和Dacific Anything Model(DAM)(Lian等人,2025年)等框架利用Saption Anything Model(SAM)(Ravi等人,2025年;Carion等人,2026年)来产生对任意区域和面具的上下文描述. Bianchi等人(2026年)提出了Patch-ioner框架,该框架采用了以补丁为中心的范式,将补丁表达汇总到对非毗连地区的连贯描述中.

blocks.en: Within the rising need for model audition tools, research on MI has developed zero-shot pipelines for assigning natural language descriptions directly to individual neurons in vision networks. As an early attempt, Network Dissection ( Bau et al., 2017 ) measures how closely a neuron’s activations align with concepts from a labeled, predetermined concept set, which ties its descriptions to the coverage and granularity of that fixed annotation vocabulary. MILAN ( Hernandez et al., 2022 ) removes the need for a pre-annotated label set by searching for an open-ended natural language string that maximizes pointwise mutual information with the image regions where a neuron is active. Its descriptions are validated through agreement with human-written descriptions. CLIP-Dissect ( Oikarinen and Weng, 2023 ) instead uses a VLM to score neuron activations against a user-specified concept set without requiring labeled probing data.
blocks.zh: 在对模型试镜工具日益增长的需求范围内,MI的研究开发了零射线管,将自然语言描述直接分配给视觉网络中的单个神经元. 作为早期尝试,网络分裂(Bau et al., 2017)衡量神经元的激活与标注的、预先确定的概念集概念的结合程度,这些概念将其描述与固定注解词汇的覆盖范围和颗粒性联系起来。 MILAN(Hernandez et al., 2022年)通过搜索一个可自由限定的自然语言字符串,使与神经元活跃的图像区域之间的指向互通信息最大化,从而消除了预注标签设置的必要性. 它的描述通过与人文描述的约定来验证. CLIP-Discept(Oikarien和Weng,2023年)转而使用VLM来比照用户指定的概念集来计分神经元激活,而不需要标注的检测数据.

blocks.en: Following the recommendations from Thasarathan et al. (2025) and Costa et al. (2025) , we train the Vanilla and TopK SAE for 30 epochs and the MP-SAE for 10 epochs with a cosine schedule, warming up the learning rate from 10 − 6 10^{-6} to 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} for the first 5 epochs, then reducing it back to 10 − 6 10^{-6} by the final epoch. For this, we coupled a LinearLR with a CosineAnnealingLR in a SequentialLR from PyTorch. The optimizer has a fixed weight decay of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . Regarding the layers in the SAEs, the encoder is a linear transformation given by W e ​ n ​ c W_{enc} in Equation 1 , along with Batch Normalization (BN). While this introduces batch-dependent statistics during training, at inference the encoder uses the fixed running mean and variance accumulated over training, so each patch embedding maps deterministically to a fixed latent code at test time. We include BN because, in preliminary trials, omitting it from the encoder consistently degraded MS, OOD Score, Coherence and Connectivity across configurations, suggesting it plays a stabilizing role in training useful dictionaries in our setting.

blocks.en: To assess how grounded the learned dictionary is in real data, we compute the Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Score ( Fel et al., 2025 ) , which measures the deviation of each dictionary atom from the closest patch-level embedding it could represent: OOD Score = 1 − 1 m ​ ∑ k = 1 m max j ⁡ ⟨ d k , e j ⟩ , \text{OOD Score}=1-\frac{1}{m}\sum_{k=1}^{m}\max_{j}\langle d_{k},e_{j}\rangle, (9) where both d k , e j ∈ ℝ p d_{k},e_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{p} are L 2 L_{2} -normalized. A score of 0 indicates that every atom exactly matches an existing activation (pure lookup behavior), while higher values indicate that atoms drift away from the real data manifold. We compute this metric using patch-level embeddings, since this is the feature space the SAE is actually trained to reconstruct; evaluating against image-level embeddings would test dictionary atoms against a distribution the encoder never observes.

blocks.en: Table 3: Extra AIS values. The p -value stems from testing the null hypothesis that the predicted and ground truth distributions of the neuron activations are uncorrelated; here we report the percent of the neurons that have this p -value less than 0.05. Errors occur whenever the simulator predicts a different number of SAE activations than in the ground truth. NaNs occur whenever ( A ^ pred , A truth ) (\hat{A}_{\text{pred}},A_{\text{truth}}) is a zero-pair. Both cases are not considered in the AIS computation.
blocks.zh: 表3:额外AIS值。 p -值来源于测试一个虚假假设,即神经元激活的预测和地面真实分布是无关的;我们在此报告这个p -值低于0.05的神经元的百分比. 每当模拟器预测出与地面真实性不同的SAE激活次数时都会发生错误. 当( A^ pred, A truth ) (\hat{A}_{\\text{pred}}, A_{\\text{ truth} 是一个零派时, NaNs 会发生 。 这两种情况都不在AIS计算中考虑。

blocks.en:
We note that the proportion of neurons reaching statistical significance (%
p < 0.05) is closely tied to the underlying strength of the predicted-vs-ground-truth correlation: configurations with markedly lower Mean and Median AIS - most notably Top-K SAEs, which score substantially below Vanilla and MP SAEs across all embedders and datasets - also show the lowest significance rates. Given that significance is computed per neuron over a comparatively small number of held-out images (namely, 10), weaker true correlations are disproportionately likely to fall below the significance threshold even when the simulator captures a genuine, if modest, relationship. We, therefore, interpret the lower significance rates for these configurations as consistent with the comparatively weak AIS scores already observed for Top-K SAEs.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到神经元具有统计意义的比例(%)
p < 0.05)与预测-vs-地面-真实关系的基本强度密切相关:平均和中度AIS-最显著的Top-K SAEs的配置,在所有嵌入器和数据集中均大大低于Vanila和MP SAEs,也显示其意义率最低。 鉴于每个神经元在相对较少的被搁置的图像(即10)中计算其重要性,即使模拟器捕捉到一种真实的,甚至微小的关系,更弱的真实关联性也极有可能低于意义阈值。 因此,我们将这些配置的较低意义率解释为与已经观察到的Top-K SAEs相对薄弱的AIS分数一致.

blocks.en: The experiment was approved by our ethics board and included 21 initial participants. Our experiment was anonymous and hosted on the Jotform platform 5 5 5 https://www.jotform.com . The subjects were informed at the very beginning that their annotations would solely be used for research purposes. Excerpts from the user interface can be found in Figure 8 .

blocks.en: We selected two of the topmost activating MP SAE neurons (trained on DINO embeddings for CUB data): one focusing on (leafless) tree branches, one on bodies of water. Just like in our automated explanation pipeline, the users were first asked to find the concept the neurons were firing for, based on 5 examples of top activating images along with the patch activation scores. The subjects were shown these scores directly on top of the images, not together with patch captions. Also, in order to reduce cognitive load, we mapped the original integer scores from [ 0 , 10 ] [0,10] to { 0 , 1 , 2 } = \{0,1,2\}= {low, medium, high} and restricted the experiment to only two neurons, as this alone took our participants 25 minutes on average to complete. In the simulation task, they were asked to annotate 10 top-random (5 top activating + 5 random) examples with these scores (16 scores per image). The images in both tasks and neurons were randomly shuffled for every user.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了两个最顶端激活的 MP SAE 神经元(训练于为 CUB 数据嵌入的 DINO ) : 一个专注于(无叶)树枝,一个用于水体. 就像我们的自动解释程序一样, 用户们首先被要求 找到神经元所要使用的概念, 基于5个例子的顶部激活图像 以及补丁激活分数。 主体直接在图像上方显示这些分数,而不是与补丁标题一起显示. 另外,为了减少认知负载,我们绘制了最初的整数分数,从[0,10][0,10]到{0,1,2}=\{0,1,2}{低,中,高},并将实验限制在两个神经元上,因为仅此一项,我们的参与者平均需要25分钟才能完成. 在模拟任务中,他们被要求对10个具有这些分数(每张图像16分)的顶级随机(5个顶级激活+5个随机)例子进行注释. 任务和神经元中的图像对每个用户都随机洗牌.

blocks.en: After collecting the survey responses, we removed the samples where the user’s explanations for both neurons were very unspecific or missing, e.g. "I don’t know" or "an object part" . This led to a total of 16 valid users, whose annotations were considered for the statistics in section 5 . The users’ responses can be found in our repository. Additionally, 3 (out of 224) user non-zero annotations in the simulation task with zero variance, i.e. all-ones or all-twos, were also removed from the average AIS values per image in Figure 3 , as the SAE ground-truth also did not contain any of this kind.

blocks.en: We looked at the MS and AIS of DINO embeddings on the CUB dataset also on various intermediate layers and compared the interpretability of the Vanilla SAE features w.r.t. to these two metrics to the interpretability of the raw DINO embeddings ( Table 4 ). We apply the same filter described in Appendix D on the raw embeddings. The explanations and simulations are generated with Gemma4-12b. Firstly, we note that the highest MS and AIS values are not in the final embeddings, but on previous layers. This is consistent with other empirical results from the SAE literature, e.g. ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Pach et al., 2026 ) , which suggests that earlier DNN layers encode more monosemantic concepts. Recent work on the phenomenon of neural collapse ( Kothapalli, 2023 ) supports this finding, while newer embedder architectures aim at dealing with this problem ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们研究了在CUB数据集上嵌入各种中间层的DINO的MS和AIS,并将Vanilla SAE特性的可解释性与这两个指标与原始DINO嵌入的可解释性进行比较(表4)。 我们在原始嵌入物上采用附录D所述的过滤器。 解释和模拟与Gemma4-12b生成. 首先,我们注意到,最高的MS和AIS值不是在最后嵌入层,而是在以前的层。 这与SAE文献中的其他经验结果一致,例如. (Huben等人,2024年;Pach等人,2026年),这说明早期的DNN层编码了更多的单语义概念. 最近关于神经崩溃现象的著作(Kothapalli, 2023)支持这一发现,而较新的嵌入式建筑则旨在解决这一问题(Siméoni等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Secondly, we observe that input embeddings across all layers have a higher MS score than their corresponding SAE features, yet lower AIS values. This inconsistency between MS and AIS seconds the lack of correlation documented in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 第二,我们观察到,嵌入到所有层的输入比它们相应的SAE特性具有更高的MS分数,但AIS值较低. MS和AIS的这种不一致之处在图4中记录的缺乏相关性。

blocks.en: Thirdly, notice the increasing frequency of NaNs ( Not a Number ) towards the earlier layers for the No-SAE case. We verified that all NaNs arise from degenerate pairs ( A ^ pred , A truth ) = ( 0 , 0 ) (\hat{A}_{\text{pred}},A_{\text{truth}})=(0,0) . On the one hand, this is evidence that the LLM simulator is consistent at the floor of the activation range and does not hallucinate non-zero activations. On the other hand, this on its own would not be sufficient evidence of a well-calibrated simulator, since a naive simulator that always predicts 0 would also pass this test; however, we confirmed that predictions on the non-degenerate pairs show meaningful variance rather than defaulting to zero.
blocks.zh: 第三,注意NaNs(不是数字)向前几层N-SAE案的频率增加。 我们证实,所有的NaN都是由变质的对(A ^ pred, A truth ) = (0, 0) (\hat{A}_{\text{pred}},A_{\text{ truth}}) = (0, 0) 产生的. 一方面,这证明LLM模拟器在激活范围底部是一致的,不会产生非零激活的幻觉. 另一方面,这本身并不能充分证明一个精准的模拟器,因为一个总是预测0的天真模拟器也会通过这个测试;然而,我们确认,对非衰变对子的预测显示有意义的差异而不是默认为0.
